sloka: प्रियेण खलु दत्तं हि पितृलोकेषु राघव ।अक्षय्यं भवतीत्याहुर्भवांश्चैव पितु: प्रिय: ॥ २.१०१.८॥
transliteration: priyeṇa khalu dattaṁ hi pitṛlokeṣu rāghava ।akṣayyaṁ bhavatītyāhurbhavāṁścaiva pitu: priya: ॥ 2.101.8॥

translations.english: O son of Raghu's race, it is said that whatever is offered by a dear son becomes eternal in the world of manes. You alone are the beloved son of our father.
